transparent.root: the trigger is the adopter's own control and the wrapper draws nothing around it, so a box class on the wrapper or above it decides the trigger's box as it decides the wrapper's

slots.panel: z-dropdown w-max max-w-[92vw] overflow-visible px-floating-x py-floating-y bg-surface-floating border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-edge-surface-floating rounded-surface-floating shadow-surface-floating font-body text-md text-ink-body/(--level-ink-body)

floating.panel: a popover floats over the page, so the region holding its trigger does not decide what it holds
